game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the magma valve.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the magma valve. Each round, smoke serpents strike the magma valve, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the magma valve from smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge: keep the power_on meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: power_on drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 41-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 41 seconds while power_on > 0.
